parameters.content:
## D-01 Lead capture, deduplicated

One webhook URL that Property Finder, Bayut, Dubizzle, Meta lead ads and your own site can all POST to. It understands each of their payload shapes.

Deduplicates on the **last 9 digits of the phone** (so +971 50 123 4567 and 0501234567 are the same person) and on email, over a 180-day window.

New leads are written straight into register **SAL-001** with a correct `DR-SAL-001-nnnn` document number taken from the portal's own `counters` table - so they are indistinguishable from a hand-typed lead.

Then it hands off to flow 03 for assignment.

**Give the portals this URL** (Production URL, once activated):
`https://<your-n8n>/webhook/dharani/lead-intake`

parameters.query:
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS dupe_count,
       COALESCE(MAX(doc_no), '') AS existing_doc_no,
       COALESCE(MAX(agent_assigned), '') AS existing_agent
FROM frm_sal_001
WHERE created_at > to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '180 days',
                           'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
  AND (
    ( $1 <> '' AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(contact,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
                   LIKE '%' || right(regexp_replace($1, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9) )
    OR ( $2 <> '' AND lower(COALESCE(notes,'')) LIKE '%' || lower($2) || '%' )
    OR ( $3 <> '' AND lower(COALESCE(client_name,'')) = lower($3) AND $1 <> ''
         AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(contact,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
             = regexp_replace($1, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') )
  );

parameters.text: =:repeat: Duplicate lead ignored - *{{ $('Normalise Lead').item.json.client_name }}* ({{ $('Normalise Lead').item.json.contact }}) already exists as {{ $json.existing_doc_no }}, owned by {{ $json.existing_agent || 'nobody yet' }}.

parameters.query:
WITH seq AS (
  INSERT INTO counters (form_code, seq) VALUES ('SAL-001', 1)
  ON CONFLICT (form_code) DO UPDATE SET seq = counters.seq + 1
  RETURNING seq
)
INSERT INTO frm_sal_001
  (doc_no, created_at, updated_at, created_by, status, notes,
   lead_id, date_received, source, client_name, contact,
   property_interest, agent_assigned)
SELECT 'DR-SAL-001-' || lpad(seq.seq::text, 4, '0'),
       to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),
       to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),
       'n8n', 'New',
       'email: ' || $1 || E'\n' || $2,
       $3, to_char(now(), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), $4, $5, $6, $7, ''
FROM seq
RETURNING id, doc_no, client_name, contact, source, property_interest;
